principles.label: Barometric pressure
principles.rule: Fish respond to pressure change: high pressure tends to produce feeding while low pressure sends fish to cover ahead of bad weather; the feed is often strongest just before a front and returns a few days after the pressure rises, while dramatic swings can shut fishing off.

citations.source: Take Me Fishing (RBFF) — The Best Time to Fish? Read the Weather (July 2016)
citations.quote: High pressure, fish eat, low pressure, fish take cover due to impending bad weather.
